host.enabledCheck: Enable calculation and output for this entire Scatter setup.
host.licenseButton: Import a team license or inspect its expiry. Existing scenes remain available after expiry.

previewUI.identificationDrop: Use Model, Layer or published Band ownership in Points, Proxy and shaded Mesh. Non-Band layouts use neutral gray (Unbanded). Render materials are unchanged.
previewUI.radiusMetricDrop: Inspect the published radius pair. This display choice does not change any spacing rule. 3D uses three orthogonal rings.

surface.removeSurfaces: Remove highlighted assignments from this setup. Scene objects are kept.
surface.sharedPick: Add a receiving surface without replacing existing assignments.
surface.surfacesButton: Add multiple receiving surfaces by name. Existing assignments are kept. Choose the target for each Paint Area under Painting.
surface.containersToggle: Optional shared source pool. Enable Global containers in a layer's Assets tab.
surface.createContainer: Create a source rectangle shared by owners that explicitly use the global pool.
surface.pickContainer: Link an existing Cyrus Source Container to the global pool.
surface.removeContainer: Unlink the rectangle while keeping its scene node and registered model settings.

manager.addButton: Add a layer and edit its controls below. Layers calculate from top to bottom.
manager.copyButton: Copy this layer, its models, surfaces and Paint Areas.
manager.removeButton: Remove this layer and its Paint Areas. Undo restores them.
manager.layerColor: Identification color for this layer. Choose Layer colors in Viewport & render to display it.
manager.nameEdit: Rename the selected layer without changing its identity.
manager.visibleCheck: Hide display only. Hidden layers still calculate and affect spacing.
manager.enabledCheck: Include this layer in calculation and final output.
manager.upButton: Evaluate earlier; earlier layers occupy space first.
manager.recipesButton: Save complete selected layers including Paint, or bind and import a saved multi-layer recipe. Browsing does not calculate scattering.

diagnostics.startButton: Record engineering events in this Max process. Off by default; at most ten minutes, 4,096 events and 4 MiB.
diagnostics.stopButton: Stop recording and retain the bounded history in memory.
diagnostics.saveButton: Choose a local JSON file, stop recording and save its retained pages. No MCP or upload is required.
diagnostics.refreshButton: Read recorder state without evaluating the scene. Status has no polling timer.

setsUI.paintedCheck: Restrict this layer to its painted areas. Turn off to scatter across all its surfaces.
setsUI.addButton: Create a named area. Painting again edits the selected area.
setsUI.removeButton: Remove the selected area. Undo restores it.
setsUI.targetList: Explicit target within this layer. An area with saved paint cannot be silently retargeted.
setsUI.enabledCheck: Enable this Paint Area's contribution to the layer.

sourceUI.sourceName: Label inside Scatter only. Clear it to use the scene object's name.
sourceUI.idColor: Viewport identification color. This does not change clustering or model frequency.
sourceUI.selectFromScene: Choose one or more source models by name.
sourceUI.addPlant: Pick a scene model for this layer.
sourceUI.addSelected: Add the currently selected scene objects to this layer.
sourceUI.removePlant: Unregister highlighted rows. To keep their settings, park models outside a source rectangle instead.
sourceUI.selectPlant: Select the highlighted source models in the scene.
sourceUI.addPoint: Add a named placeholder type. Scatter points now, then replace this row with a model.
sourceUI.addEmpty: Add a weighted empty source for intentional gaps in candidate-budget mode.
sourceUI.replacePoint: Use a scene model for the selected Point; keep its identity, settings and Band assignments.
sourceUI.makePoint: Use the selected model row as a Point. Keep its settings and registration; do not delete the scene object.
sourceUI.existingGroups: Assign highlighted sources to an existing color group for clustering.
sourceUI.groupColor: Assign a color group to highlighted sources when the color is accepted.
sourceUI.applyColor: Assign the chosen color group to all highlighted source rows.
sourceUI.weightSpin: Relative model frequency in this layer. Zero disables the model.
sourceUI.sourceZSpin: Offset instances of highlighted models along world Z.
sourceUI.sourceScaleSpin: Per-model scale multiplier. 1 keeps the model's original scale.
sourceUI.radiusSourceSpin: Collision footprint radius for highlighted source rows, in scene units.
sourceUI.radiusModeDrop: Auto bounds supported model geometry around its pivot after final instance scale and orientation. This is conservative spacing, not mesh collision or Band containment.
sourceUI.followRadiusCheck: Scale this source's collision footprint with its instance scale.
sourceUI.showRadiusCheck: Show this source's radius in the viewport; does not change collision rules.
sourceUI.forwardAxis: The model's local forward direction, used for orientation.
sourceUI.detailsToggle: Show or hide these advanced controls; their saved settings are preserved.

sourceContainersUI.modeList: Use the model list directly, or optionally collect models from source rectangles.
sourceContainersUI.enabledCheck: Enable the selected rectangle to collect models. New rectangles start off so you can position them first. Manual mode needs Update.
sourceContainersUI.createContainer: Create an inactive source rectangle. Position it around model pivots, then enable collection.
sourceContainersUI.pickContainer: Link a Cyrus container, or copy a square-corner Rectangle into a container. The original spline is preserved.
sourceContainersUI.removeContainer: Unlink this rectangle without deleting it or registered source settings.

distributionUI.presetsButton: Save or apply named population settings. Assets and receiver references are preserved.
distributionUI.countSpin: Layer population before eligibility, up to 1,000,000. All layers and retries share the Scatter's 1,000,000 candidate limit.
distributionUI.densitySpin: Requested plants per square metre; capped at 1,000,000 per layer. All layers and retries share the Scatter's 1,000,000 candidate limit.
distributionUI.seedSpin: Deterministic generation seed. Changing it can invalidate existing Edit bindings.
distributionUI.densityButton: Use the selected receiver UV channel: white permits candidates; black excludes them. UVs clamp to 0..1.
distributionUI.invertCheck: Reverse the density map's white and black eligibility.
distributionUI.uvChannelSpin: Receiver texture coordinates, channels 1..99. Missing or invalid mapping retains the previous complete result.
distributionUI.resolutionList: Sampled map detail. Higher resolutions cost more time and memory; tiny features may need more samples. Default: 128 x 128.
distributionUI.meshCheck: Thin this layer using values stored on each receiving mesh. Combines with Paint, texture density and slope/altitude filters.
distributionUI.meshChannelSpin: 0 reads vertex colors; 1..99 read numbered mesh map channels. These are values, independent of density UV coordinates.
distributionUI.meshComponentList: Read one component of the selected mesh channel. Match Data Channel's Vertex Output component.
distributionUI.meshMinSpin: Channel value mapped to 0 before Invert and the Density curve. Must be less than Input max.
distributionUI.meshMaxSpin: Channel value mapped to 1 before Invert and the Density curve. Values outside the range clamp.
distributionUI.meshInvertCheck: Reverse the normalized channel values before applying the Density curve.
distributionUI.meshCurveButton: Remap normalized mesh values into planting eligibility. Left is 0; right is 1.
distributionUI.meshPreviewButton: Read a snapshot of the current mask as at most 2,048 grayscale face-centre markers. White permits plants; black excludes. Refresh after edits.
distributionUI.meshHideButton: Hide the cached mesh mask markers without recalculating plants.

populationPolicyUI.populationList: Budget evaluates the generated candidates; target makes bounded replacement attempts.
populationPolicyUI.attemptSpin: Maximum candidate attempts as a multiple of the requested population.
populationPolicyUI.roundSpin: Maximum rounds of eligibility, collision and cleanup. A shortfall can remain.
populationPolicyUI.repairCheck: Allow bounded retries for plants removed by final cleanup.

areaUI.addAreaScene: Choose closed Area shapes by name.
areaUI.pickArea: Pick a closed shape as an include/exclude Area shared by all sets in this layer.
areaUI.removeArea: Unlink highlighted Areas and their falloff settings; keep the scene shapes.
areaUI.refreshAreas: Refresh Area geometry and recalculate the layer preview.
areaUI.aaPick: Choose an existing Cyrus Surface Analyzer for line or point masks.
areaUI.aaRemove: Disable and unlink the layer's Analyzer Area mask.
areaUI.aaLine: Use the Analyzer centre line as an XY mask; unions with its point mask.
areaUI.aaWidth: Full width of the Analyzer centre-line Area mask.
areaUI.aaCaps: Flat or round ends for the line mask.
areaUI.aaStreetOffset: Lateral offset from the Analyzer centre line.
areaUI.aaPoints: Use discs around Analyzer points as an XY mask.
areaUI.aaRadius: Radius of each Analyzer point mask.
areaUI.slopeCheck: Eligibility from world up: 0 degrees upward, 90 vertical, 180 underside. Protected Edit plants are retained.
areaUI.slopeMinSpin: Minimum slope in degrees. Zero inside fade includes this endpoint.
areaUI.slopeMaxSpin: Maximum slope in degrees; plant alignment does not affect surface slope.
areaUI.slopeLowerSpin: Inside fade above the minimum, in degrees. Fades must not overlap.
areaUI.slopeUpperSpin: Inside fade below the maximum, in degrees. Fades must not overlap.
areaUI.altitudeMinSpin: Minimum world Z of the final receiver anchor, before source offsets.
areaUI.altitudeMaxSpin: Maximum world Z of the final receiver anchor, in scene units.
areaUI.altitudeLowerSpin: Inside fade above minimum height. Zero keeps the hard endpoint.
areaUI.altitudeUpperSpin: Inside fade below maximum height. Fades must not overlap.
areaUI.altitudeCheck: World Z eligibility. Fades reduce density inside the range; source Z offsets do not change eligibility.
areaUI.fallTarget: Edit Analyzer boundary falloff or one highlighted Area's independent falloff.
areaUI.fallPick: Choose the Analyzer whose boundary drives this falloff.
areaUI.fallRemove: Unlink the falloff Analyzer and disable its falloff effects.
areaUI.fallDeleteCheck: Exclude an edge band before scale and density ramps begin.
areaUI.fallDeleteSpin: Width of the excluded edge band in scene units.
areaUI.fallScaleCheck: Vary instance scale with distance from this boundary.
areaUI.fallScaleSpin: Distance over which the scale curve is evaluated.
areaUI.fallDensityCheck: Vary candidate eligibility with distance from this boundary.
areaUI.fallDensitySpin: Distance over which the density curve is evaluated.
areaUI.detailsToggle: Show or hide these advanced controls; their saved settings are preserved.

brushUI.modeRadio: Paint adds coverage and merges overlapping strokes. Erase removes coverage and cuts holes.
brushUI.radiusSpin: Distance from the brush center to its edge. A 100 mm radius paints a 200 mm wide stroke.
brushUI.beginButton: Start painting or erasing on this Paint Area's receiving surface.
brushUI.fillButton: Cover the entire receiving surface with this Paint Area.
brushUI.emptyButton: Remove all painted coverage from this area.
brushUI.densitySpin: Control this area's planting density. 100% keeps its full density before other masks and filters.
brushUI.overlayMode: Show painted borders, bounded coverage samples, or hide the Paint overlay.
brushUI.overlayColor: Set this Paint Area's viewport overlay color.
brushUI.insideSpin: Distance inside the painted border for the density and size transition. Both fade distances at zero create a hard edge.
brushUI.outsideSpin: Extend the transition beyond the painted border, within the receiving surface. Both fade distances at zero create a hard edge.
brushUI.densityFade: Gradually thin plants across the fade region using the Density curve.
brushUI.densityCurve: Shape the density transition. Left is the outer end; right is the fully interior end.
brushUI.scaleFade: Vary plant size across the fade region using Edge scale, Inner scale and the Scale curve.
brushUI.scaleMin: Outer-end size multiplier with the default curve. 0.5 means half size; 1 means unchanged. Must not exceed Inner scale.
brushUI.scaleMax: Interior size multiplier with the default curve. 1 means unchanged; 2 means double size. Must be at least Edge scale.
brushUI.scaleCurve: Shape the size transition. Left is the outer end; right is the fully interior end.
brushUI.exportSpline: Export this area's closed contours and holes as an independent editable spline on the receiver's local XY plane (local Z=0). Keeps the Paint Area; selects the snapshot. Stop the brush first.
brushUI.importMode: Replace this area's coverage, or union imported coverage with it. Closed loops use even-odd fill and project along receiver-local Z. Source spline is preserved.
brushUI.splineTolerance: Maximum projected curve approximation error in world units. Smaller values create more vertices; import is limited to 8,192 samples. The receiver's Paint precision also sets a minimum.
brushUI.importSpline: Pick one closed spline shape to apply to this Paint Area using Replace or Add. One Undo; Manual waits for Update. Stop the brush first.

randomUI.presetsButton: Save or apply named transforms settings. Assets and receiver references are preserved.
randomUI.projectCheck: Project random movement back onto the receiving surface.
randomUI.alignCheck: Align instances to the receiving surface normal.
randomUI.resetRotation: Reset only this layer's random rotation limits. Undo is available.
randomUI.resetScale: Reset only this layer's separate X, Y and Z scale limits.
randomUI.resetWholeScale: Reset only this layer's uniform scale multiplier.
randomUI.resetMovement: Reset only this layer's random translation limits.

diversityUI.selectAnalyzer: Select the linked Surface Analyzer in the scene.
diversityUI.updateAnalyzer: Analyze the linked guide. In Manual mode, use Update scatter afterwards to publish placements.
diversityUI.divSeedSpin: Change source assignment randomness without changing the generation seed.
diversityUI.cornerMode: Rounded uses Euclidean distance. Sharp uses bounded miter offsets; complex Paths may require simplification.
diversityUI.arrangementMode: Consecutive accumulates widths. Independent permits overlapping Start/End ranges and uses a shared candidate population.
diversityUI.pickAnalyzer: Use Surface Analyzer output for bands, rows and fixed anchors.
diversityUI.pickPath: Pick a spline for Line Pattern assignment.
diversityUI.removePath: Remove the selected assignment path while keeping the scene spline.
diversityUI.addOutside: Add a source-assignment band outside the selected path.
diversityUI.addInside: Add a source-assignment band inside the selected path.
diversityUI.removeStrokeButton: Remove the selected band and its settings.
diversityUI.bandStart: Independent range starts at this physical distance from its Path.
diversityUI.bandEnd: Independent range must end after Start.
diversityUI.bandStrength: Band contribution before other masks and spacing. Independent overlaps share one candidate population.
diversityUI.bandCurveCheck: Use the saved sampled density curve from Start to End.
diversityUI.bandScaleMode: Multiply the random Band size by the effective density curve shape or an independent Custom scale curve. Density % is not a size multiplier.
diversityUI.bandScaleEdit: Size multiplier across this Band. 100% preserves size; zero collapses size without deleting the placement. Edit in Custom mode.
diversityUI.bandCurveEdit: Edit this Band by its captured identity. Changes apply on drag release, Apply or Close.
diversityUI.bandColor: Identification color belongs to this Band. It never changes placements or source materials.
diversityUI.fieldFalloffCheck: Sample Band density on receiver surfaces before other masks, spacing and cleanup. This never changes plant counts.
diversityUI.fieldBoundaryCheck: Show admitted start/end contours clipped to every receiver surface, including stacked and vertical receivers.
diversityUI.fieldView: Selected Band shows its contribution. Combined shows capped total occupancy.
diversityUI.fieldSampleSpin: Bounded visualization samples; sparse coverage can miss narrow intervals. Show Boundaries preserves admitted outlines.
diversityUI.bandUp: Move the selected Band up on its Path. Consecutive priority and ranges follow authored order.
diversityUI.bandDown: Move the selected Band down on its Path. Independent decisions keep stable Band identities.
diversityUI.strokeScaleMin: Additional Band multiplier, combined once with source, layer and transform scale.
diversityUI.strokeScaleMax: Additional Band multiplier; it does not change the source asset or its base Scale setting.
diversityUI.refreshGroups: Refresh available source color groups for assignment.

proceduralUI.presetsButton: Save or apply named spacing settings. Assets and receiver references are preserved.
proceduralUI.scopeList: Choose spacing within the selected layer or between it and another layer.

instanceRadiusUI.radiusMode: Use an absolute world radius or multiply the selected instances' source radius.
instanceRadiusUI.radiusSpin: Value applied only when Set selected radii is pressed.
instanceRadiusUI.applyRadius: Apply radius overrides to selected instances in this layer.
instanceRadiusUI.resetRadius: Restore the selected instances' inherited source radii.
instanceRadiusUI.clearRadius: Remove instance-radius overrides for this layer.

spacingUI.relaxCheck: Separate nearby candidates on the receiving surface before Brush, artist edits and spacing. Fixed anchors stay fixed.
spacingUI.boundaryRelaxCheck: Smooth candidate neighborhoods with bounded movement. Eligibility is checked before publication; author edits run afterwards.

separationUI.cleanCheck: Remove isolated plants after spacing. Protected instance edits remain.

detailsUI.refreshButton: Read the existing calculation statistics without regenerating placements.
detailsUI.helpButton: Explain settings ownership, display budgets, evaluation order and policy limits.

properties.enabledCheck: Collect models whose pivots are inside this rectangle. Off lets you position it without collecting or moving models. Manual mode needs Update.
properties.consumerList: Choose a linked setup or layer. Inactive pools remain editable; this changes the view only.
properties.widthSpin: Resize the boundary. Source models keep their transforms.
properties.assignOwner: Resolve overlapping movement ownership for the selected source. Its usage and settings in other sets are unchanged.
